 €14.99 per uur - Logistics - 36 hour 
Do you want to work as an HLO (Man Up) Orderpicker at the large logistics company Van der Helm? 
The job is done with a tall Combi Truck. The worker sits inside the cabin of the machine. The cabin is big enough, so the worker has space to sit and move safely. The machine can go very high, up to 12-16 meters. The worker goes up together with the cabin. Before going up, the worker puts an empty pallet on the forks. Sometimes there is a full pallet on the forks if it needs to be placed in the rack. 
When you are is high in the air, you takes boxes from the shelves by hand. The boxes can weigh between 15 and 20 kilos, depending on the product. The worker puts the boxes on the empty pallet or places full pallets into the rack. After finishing the work, the machine goes down. The worker drives the truck to another place in the warehouse. 
 Job Requirements 
 - HLO (Man Up) certificate or willing to get it - Not afraid to work in height - Physicaly ready to work - English speaking - Detailed orientated 
 Employment conditions 
 - Employment contract with Charlie works - Provided training and cursus for the HLO if you are not experienced but willing to learn. - Health Insurance - Possibility for organized accommodation Organized transport to work - Weekly payments Opportunity for professional growth - Travel allowance - Work in a modern logistics environment - Canteen where you can get food and drinks Van der Helm offers total solutions in the field of logistics services.

As a Reach Truck Driver, you play an important role in the warehouse operation. You ensure that goods are moved, stored and prepared safely and efficiently, keeping the logistics process running smoothly. 
Your daily tasks include: - Operating a reach truck to move and store pallets; - Replenishing warehouse stock locations; - Loading and unloading goods; - Assisting with order picking when needed; - Checking products and storage locations; - Contributing to a safe, clean and efficient warehouse. Opdrachtgever 
You will be working for a modern and growing company in the food industry, located in Son, near Eindhoven. Every day, products are processed and distributed to customers throughout the Netherlands. 
You will work in a temperature-controlled warehouse, but you'll be part of a warm and supportive team where teamwork, safety and quality are key. Vereisten 
We are looking for someone who: - Holds a valid Reach Truck certificate; - Has experience operating a Reach Truck; - Works accurately and safely; - Is reliable and takes responsibility; - Speaks English or Dutch; - Is available to work full-time; - Is willing to work in a 2-shift system. 
Working Hours - Morning Shift: 06:30 - 14:30 - Afternoon Shift: 14:30 - 22:30 Wat bieden wij - €18.48 gross per hour, including shift allowance (21+); - Holiday allowance; - Travel reimbursement; - Pension scheme; - Full-time position (40 hours per week); - Stable employment with a growing company; - A friendly and supportive working environment; - Training and career development opportunities; - Opportunity to obtain a permanent contract; - Thorough onboarding and guidance during your first weeks.
